name: opt_inherit2.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (c Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptP (mk-OptP (a Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptC (mk-OptC (a Int)(b Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptP (sel-OptP OptP))
  (lift-OptC (sel-OptC OptC))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptP ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptP (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptP ((this Ref)) OptP
  (sel-OptP (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptC ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptC (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptC ((this Ref)) OptC
  (sel-OptC (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptP ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-OptP this)
    (deref-is-OptC this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptC ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptC this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.c: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!c ((this Ref)) Ref
  (c (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class OptP:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for OptP.a: ---

(define-fun OptP!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-OptP this))
)

; ---------------------------
;   Getters for class OptC:
; ---------------------------

; --- getters for OptC.a: ---

(define-fun OptC!a ((this Ref)) Int
  (a (deref-OptC this))
)

; --- getters for OptC.b: ---

(define-fun OptC!b ((this Ref)) Int
  (b (deref-OptC this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptC (TopLevelDeclarations!c this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptP:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptP OptP)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptP.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptP!a this) 3)
)

(assert (! (OptP.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))



; -----------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptC:
; -----------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-OptC OptC)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptC.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptC!a this) 3)
)

(assert (! (OptC.inv1 2) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptC.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptC!b this) (+ (OptC!a this) 2))
)

(assert (! (OptC.inv2 2) :named _xkassert3))




; ================================
; === Optimization Objectives: ===
; ================================

(minimize (+ (let ((this 1)) (OptP!a this)) (let ((this 2)) (OptC!a this)) (let ((this 2)) (OptC!b this))))

; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptP const-1-OptP))
        2 (lift-OptC const-2-OptC))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-OptP () OptP
  (mk-OptP 3))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (a (sel-OptC (select heap 2))) 2)))
  (>= (b (sel-OptC (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (c (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptC a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (a (sel-OptP (select heap 1))) 3))
(define-fun const-2-OptC () OptC
  (mk-OptC 3 5))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (>= (a (sel-OptC (select heap 2))) 3))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2)))
                  1
                  (lift-OptP (mk-OptP 3)))))
  (store a!1 2 (lift-OptC (mk-OptC 3 5)))))
